subject: learning/code-internal-memory-codeinventory-61342f315683
statement: Package codeinventory deterministically classifies and hashes first-party production units from supplied pinned-tree entries and exact blob bytes: non-test Go packages under cmd, internal, or pkg; executable .sh and .mjs files; and regular or executable sourced .zsh files. It excludes test, fixture, generated, and vendor trees and fails closed on irregular paths, modes, duplicates, or missing blobs.
intent: Make the production-code closure complete and reproducible, including sourced shell behavior that has no executable bit.
rationale: The prior implementation and Learning treated production scripts as executable artifacts; the adopted Codex startup wrapper is sourced at mode 100644 and must participate in code-memory drift checks.
fit_criterion: Codeinventory and pinned-snapshot tests prove order-independent identities, mode and byte sensitivity, inclusion of regular and executable zsh, exclusion rules, and rejection of malformed entries or absent blob bytes.

provenance.note: Supersedes the pre-zsh inventory description after sourced production scripts entered the closure.
